title: cuphea grisebachiana
intro: Cuphea grisebachiana, commonly known as the Red Cuphea, is a plant species belonging to the Lythraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties. The health benefits of Cuphea grisebachiana include its potential to support weight loss and improve lipid profiles due to its high content of palmitoleic acid, a fatty acid with anti-obesity properties. The therapeutic actions of Cuphea grisebachiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
